## Highlights

- **Rule classes you can switch.** Every rule is now `signature`, `contextual` or `heuristic`. Switch whole classes with `[settings.rule_classes]` and single rules with `[settings.rules]`. Both are boolean maps merged per key across config layers, and a rule-id switch wins over its class switch.
- **The keywordless catch-all `generic-high-entropy-value` is off by default.** It caused almost every false positive. Named credentials stay covered by the contextual rules: on 17 local repositories, findings dropped from 385 to 199, and all 186 removed findings came from that rule. With the rule opted back in, results match 0.8.0 rule by rule.
- **Contextual rules now read unquoted named credentials**, such as `HF_TOKEN=...`, `export DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=...`, yaml values and `-e`/`env` arguments.
- **Built-in reference for humans and agents.** `sekretbarilo help config` documents the full configuration syntax, and `help rules [--defaults]` lists the resolved class and state of every rule.
- **Config errors are fatal and safe.** A config layer that is broken or not utf-8 stops the run with path, line and column instead of being skipped silently. The message never quotes config contents.
- **False positives fixed at the root** in the value grammar, the exemption steps and the rule patterns. Parser-based literals posture now also covers C/C++, Python, JS/TS and Swift. Signature prefixes must start at a word boundary.

## Upgrade notes

- `redact-claude` and `check-file` no longer mask random tokens that have no name and no prefix. Restore that with:
  ```toml
  [settings.rules]
  "generic-high-entropy-value" = true
  ```
- `tier3_skip_test_paths` is renamed `heuristic_skip_test_paths`. The old spelling still works as a deprecated alias, but setting both in one file is an error.
- Unknown class names and rule ids in the switch maps are errors.
- Allowlists that target `generic-high-entropy-value` have no effect until that rule is enabled.

Upgrade: `brew upgrade vshuraeff/tap/sekretbarilo`, then `sekretbarilo doctor`. `doctor` now reports class states, rule overrides and the enabled/total rule count.

## Changes

### Rule classes and switches
- Every rule declares `class = signature | contextual | heuristic`. The signature and contextual classes are on by default, and the heuristic class is off.
- A custom rule without `class` inherits the class of the built-in rule with the same id; a rule with a new id is contextual.
- `scan` validates the config even when nothing is staged. `--no-defaults` validates switch ids against the full rule inventory.
- Agent hooks parse every trusted config layer strictly and fail closed; untrusted layers stay ignored.
- `--trace-exemptions` prints a `rule:disabled` or `rule:gated` line once per run for each affected rule.
- A CLI config error ends with `see: sekretbarilo help config`.

### Contextual rules
- `generic-api-key`, `generic-secret-assignment` and `generic-token-assignment` read unquoted env and yaml values wherever an assignment starts on a line. That includes the line start, whitespace, `; & | (`, yaml list items and `export`/`env`/`-e`, under any key name ending in the key word.
- Paths, variable references, word values and code expressions are suppressed, but only when the whole value is not opaque.
- A trailing `;` or `,` is treated as a separator, not as part of the value.
- Hash context is read from the assignment itself. Hex keys of exactly 32, 40 or 64 characters are measured over their hex symbols.
- `openai-api-key` drops `sk-proj-` placeholders whose payload is below 3.0 bits per byte.

### Heuristic exemption layer (when `generic-high-entropy-value` is enabled), fourteen steps
- **Value grammar:**
  - Quoted values accept Python and C/C++ string prefixes and Swift raw strings.
  - Python f-string and t-string bodies are judged piece by piece around their holes (`exempt:hole`).
  - A trailing `&` run and a shell `&&` end an unquoted value.
- **Parser clip:** a finding that straddles a literal body and a hole, prefix or delimiter is reduced to the body segments it touches (`exempt:clip`).
- **Regex step:** runs on every surface, including unquoted `/body/flags` values and patterns passed to regex-taking commands.
- **Syntax step:** recognises macro heads, member chains (`.`, `?.`, `::`, `->`), type expressions, Go type heads and calls left open at the end of a line.
- **Path steps:** recognise shell parameter expansion, module paths, JSON pointers with `$` segments, keyed relative paths and dated file names.
- **URL and markup:** recognise xml/plist/html element text, autolinks, badge chains, slugs, form-encoded queries, email addresses and action pins of the form `owner/repo@vN`.
- **Digest step:** recognises go.sum `h1:` values and subresource-integrity sha256/384/512 values.
- **Word step:** recognises framework-prefixed, Hungarian and numbered camel identifiers, and alternations of the form `a|b|c`.
- **New `symbols` and `template` steps.**

### Source posture
- Literals posture now runs on bounded, complete tree-sitter parses for C/C++, Python, JS/TS and Swift (tree-sitter 0.27.0), alongside the Rust and Go trackers. When the lexical state is unknown, the whole candidate is kept.
- The test-path skip also matches `test`, `spec`, `specs`, `__tests__`, `*_tests`, `*-tests` and XCTest target names.

### Other detectors
- Signature prefix rules start at a word boundary, after a string escape, after a `%HH` escape or after an ANSI color or erase sequence.
- `age-secret-key` matches the upper-case bech32 form.
- OpenAI project keys accept the url-safe body.
- `generic-password-assignment` accepts long mixed-case alphanumeric values and rejects a dictionary word followed by digits. Prose is never treated as a password.

### Hooks, diff and CLI
- Redaction resumes inside quoted phrases.
- Call-argument context carries across line breaks.
- Unified diffs with CRLF line endings parse.
- Codex config trust ignores inherited git variables.
- `--help` is accepted after any subcommand.

### Dependencies, CI and docs
- Updated dependencies: bstr 1.13.1, toml 1.1.6, tree-sitter 0.27.0.
- Updated action pins: checkout 7.0.1, setup-rust-toolchain 2.0.0, git-cliff-action 4.9.1, action-gh-release 3.0.3.
- New release-candidate workflow and a CI gate for tagged releases.
- Fuzz targets cover hook payloads, predicates, literal trackers and source posture.
- Docs split into Diataxis quadrants. ADR 0001-0003 carry a 0.9.0 rule-class amendment.
